# fondof

Forge fitted skills from what you learn. Public URL: https://fondof.netlify.app

## WebMCP tools

- search_skills(query) — search the public skill pool.
- get_skill(skill_hash) — fetch a public skill by its hash.
- compose_skill({ need | url | urls, repo?, top_shards? }) — create a new skill from a need or up to 4 source URLs. Returns markdown, skill_hash, skill_url, source_title and source_urls.

## Agent notes

- Pass multiple source URLs in the `urls` array, not as repeated calls.
- Cite `source_urls` when presenting composed skills.
- If compose_skill returns a quota error, ask the user to sign in or share a public skill.
